project_name: Focus PMS - Sales & Marketing Performance Management System

core_principles: Official Focus Engineering Enterprise Product aesthetic: professional, structured, clean
No unnecessary gradients, gloss, or frivolous motion; data density and clarity first
Strict compliance with official corporate palette: Deep Purple (#262262), Corporate Blue (#264494), Cyan (#51C5DC), Yellow (#EAE950), Orange (#F19A2F), Purple (#903B96), Pink (#E81B90)
Role-aware experience for 4 key personas: Management Board (DJ Sir), HOD (Manoj Mohan), User Admin (Kiran Kulkarni), Sales/Marketing Team (Kiran, Vijay, Satvinder, Kabir, Kriti, Mounika)
Indian Currency (INR - ₹) with Lakhs/Crores formatting (e.g., ₹1.25 Cr, ₹45.50 L) and configurable Financial Year (default FY 2026-27)
High density, scan-friendly grids with crisp borders and subtle neutral backgrounds (#F8F9FA)
Every interactive element and key informational field MUST include a data-testid attribute

typography.font_family: Arial, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif

navigation_sidebar.logo_container: h-16 flex items-center px-4 bg-[#1e1a4f] border-b border-[#342f7c]
navigation_sidebar.gear_icon_colors: Deep Purple & Cyan SVG gear element
navigation_sidebar.nav_item_style: flex items-center gap-3 px-3 py-2.5 rounded-md text-sm font-medium transition-colors

elements: Persona / Role Switcher dropdown (Management Board, HOD, Admin, Contributor)
Current User Profile menu (Kiran Kulkarni / DJ Sir / Manoj Mohan)

content_grid.kpi_grid: grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 lg:gap-6
content_grid.table_container: bg-white rounded-lg border border-slate-200 shadow-sm overflow-hidden

buttons.primary: bg-[#264494] hover:bg-[#1e3576] text-white font-medium px-4 py-2 rounded-md shadow-sm transition-colors text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#51C5DC]
buttons.secondary: bg-white border border-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-50 text-slate-700 font-medium px-4 py-2 rounded-md shadow-sm transition-colors text-sm
buttons.accent: bg-[#51C5DC] hover:bg-[#3db3cb] text-[#262262] font-semibold px-4 py-2 rounded-md transition-colors text-sm
buttons.danger: bg-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-700 text-white font-medium px-4 py-2 rounded-md text-sm

kpi_cards.wrapper: bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-lg p-5 shadow-sm hover:border-[#51C5DC] transition-all relative overflow-hidden
kpi_cards.accent_bar: absolute top-0 left-0 right-0 h-1 bg-[#264494]
kpi_cards.title: text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 mb-1
kpi_cards.subtext: text-xs text-slate-500 mt-2 flex items-center gap-1

tables.header_row: bg-slate-50 border-b border-slate-200 text-xs font-bold text-slate-600 uppercase tracking-wider
tables.body_row: border-b border-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-50/80 transition-colors text-sm text-slate-700

forms_and_modals.input: w-full rounded-md border border-slate-300 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-sm text-slate-900 placeholder-slate-400 focus:border-[#264494] focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#264494]
forms_and_modals.select: w-full rounded-md border border-slate-300 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-sm text-slate-900 focus:border-[#264494] focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#264494]
forms_and_modals.modal_overlay: fixed inset-0 bg-slate-900/40 backdrop-blur-sm z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4
forms_and_modals.modal_content: bg-white rounded-xl shadow-xl max-w-2xl w-full max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto border border-slate-200 p-6

management_board.focus: High-level aggregate sales performance, revenue against target, department conversion rates, campaign ROI, regional breakdown, strategic growth KPIs.

hod.focus: Team-wide KPI performance, pipeline health, target completion by sales contributor, sales split approvals, campaign lead allocations.

admin.focus: User management, invite employee via email, role & module permission matrix, team structural assignment, activation/deactivation, audit logging.

contributor.focus: Personal sales quota & activity KPIs, active lead & opportunity pipeline, primary vs supporting contribution split, content calendar, follow-up logs.

testing_requirements.data_testid_policy: Mandatory data-testid on all interactive buttons, inputs, tabs, role switches, filters, metrics cards, table rows, and modals.
testing_requirements.naming_convention: kebab-case role-based attributes e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button', data-testid='persona-switcher-select', data-testid='opportunity-split-slider'
